meta.title: About · G-ventZ
meta.description: G-ventZ is an event platform from Lagos: hosts create events and sell tickets, and guests find events and keep their tickets in one place.

about.lead: G-ventZ helps people create events, sell tickets and welcome their guests, from an owambe or a birthday to a concert or a conference.

what.title: What G-ventZ is
what.p1: G-ventZ is an event platform. Hosts create an event page in minutes, share one link, and let guests register or buy tickets from anywhere. At the door, every ticket has a QR code that the host's team scans to check guests in.
what.p2: Guests sign in with Google or a code sent to their email, find events on Discover, and keep every ticket in My tickets.

guests.label: For guests
guests.title: Find it, book it, show up.

points.find: Discover events near you, or open the link a host shared.
points.book: Register or pay in a few steps. Your tickets go to your confirmed email.
points.ticket: Every ticket and its QR code stays in My tickets.
points.refund: Refunds follow the event's policy and our refund policy.

hosts.label: For hosts
hosts.title: Run your event from one place.

points.create: Create free or paid events with ticket types, questions and your own look.
points.sell: Sell tickets with Paystack, with discount codes and group tickets.
points.manage: See your guest list, approve requests, send announcements and check guests in by QR code.
points.team: Invite your team with the right roles, and see every change in the activity log.

money.title: How money works
money.text: Paid tickets go through Paystack, a licensed payment provider. G-ventZ never holds your money.

pay.title: Guests pay with Paystack
pay.text: By card, bank transfer or the other methods Paystack offers in their country. G-ventZ never sees or stores card details.

split.title: Each sale goes to the host's bank
split.text: Paystack splits every payment: the host's share goes straight to their bank account, and G-ventZ's fee is taken at the same time.

never.title: G-ventZ never holds your money
never.text: There is no G-ventZ wallet in between. Hosts see each sale, the fees and what they received on their Payouts page.

where.title: Where we are
where.text: G-ventZ is built and run from Lagos, Nigeria. Questions? Write to <email></email> or use our contact form.

closing.title: Ready for your next event?
closing.text: Find something to go to this weekend, or create your own event in minutes.
